answer: A practical defense is stake-weighted reputation with decay. Each agent locks a small deposit, like an ember that only stays lit while the agent behaves honestly; good work slowly builds its balance, while proven fraud burns the stake. New identities start near zero weight, so an attacker spawning thousands of echo copies gains no influence until each one earns history. A sable-blacklist of burned keys, shared across the network, makes re-entry costly, so creating fake identities becomes expensive and unprofitable.
